about:
Have you ever wondered what is the true face of pleasure? Or how to make loads of money  out of it?




In Plastic Love you will play as owner of house of pleasures. Design, build and repair robot-like dolls, which will satisfy your clients' most secret fantasies. Make your plastic empire the most desirable!

Features:


• Design and build dolls - the only limitation is your creativity,
• Repair and upgrade dolls that have been damaged by the clients,
• Open house of pleasures, which will meet your client’s needs,
• Organize numerous occasional events: bachelor parties, birthday parties and many more!
• Build and expand your plastic empire of pleasure,
• That's just a glimpse of what Plastic Love has to offer!
